rule: The protein route (LFQ and TMT imports on the on-disk owner, KIT-020) runs the DIA route's protein QC, normalisation, correlation, export and DA steps unchanged; its units are the DIA step map's for those steps (kit-001/step-map.json, confirmed there). The two route-specific rows are the import (protein-level readers) and the design (the LFQ/TMT branch of the design builder). No step is declared here beyond those already declared for DIA; the rows carry no flag.

units.row: each row's result depends on that row only (given the design and any declared global statistics)
units.feature_group: depends only on the rows of one feature group (the grouping column is named)
units.whole_matrix: uses a statistic or model over all rows and samples; runs once on one projected object under the cap
units.store: not a data kernel: import adoption, design, session export

steps.label: Import
steps.module: R/mod_prot_import_server_helpers.R (process_data observer; initializeDIANativeImport attaches the owner for maxquant/fragpipe/spectronaut/pd_tmt, KIT-020)

steps.label: Design
steps.module: R/mod_prot_design_state_helpers.R (buildProtDesignStateCheckpoint, LFQ/TMT branch: protein x run pivot, log2(x + 1))
